class.name: Nintendo3DS
class.brief_description: Access to 3DS hardware: the 3D slider, the stereo settings, 2D depth, and screen capture.
class.description: [Nintendo3DS] is available as the singleton [code skip-lint]Nintendo3DS[/code] on the 3DS. The stock editor doesn't know the class, so reach it through [method Engine.get_singleton] and check [method Engine.has_singleton] first: [codeblock] var n3ds = Engine.get_singleton("Nintendo3DS") if Engine.has_singleton("Nintendo3DS") else null [/codeblock] In the fork's editor the class exists too and returns neutral values for the hardware queries, but [method set_depth] and [method get_depth] work there, so the depth you set is saved with the scene. [b]Stereo 3D:[/b] every [Camera3D] is rendered once per eye whenever the 3D slider is up. The eye separation and convergence come from the project settings [code]rendering/3ds/stereo/max_separation[/code] (default 0.12) and [code]rendering/3ds/stereo/convergence[/code] (default 3.0). [method set_stereo_separation] and [method set_stereo_convergence] override them for the current scene; a negative value restores the project settings. [b]2D depth:[/b] [method set_depth] moves a [CanvasItem] in front of or behind the screen plane. See [method set_depth] for the details. [b]Hardware:[/b] [method get_3d_slider] gives the slider position from 0.0 (off) to 1.0. [method is_new_3ds] tells you which console is running, so a game can scale effects down on the slower original. [method get_battery_level] gives 0 to 5, and [method is_charging] says whether the console is on charge.

method.name: get_3d_slider
method.description: Returns the 3D slider position, from [code]0.0[/code] (off, one image) to [code]1.0[/code] (full depth). Always [code]0.0[/code] outside the 3DS.

method.name: get_audio_stats
method.description: Returns a dictionary about the DSP audio driver: [code]active[/code] (bool), [code]buffers_played[/code] (int), and [code]last_peak[/code] (float, the loudest sample of the last buffer). Use it to check that sound is playing.

method.name: get_battery_level
method.description: Returns the battery level from [code]0[/code] (empty) to [code]5[/code] (full). Returns [code]0[/code] outside the 3DS.

method.name: get_depth
method.description: Returns the depth set on [param item] with [method set_depth]. An item that uses its parent's material reports the parent's depth. Returns [code]0.0[/code] for an item with no depth.

method.name: get_stereo_convergence
method.description: Returns the convergence in use: the value set with [method set_stereo_convergence], or the project setting.

method.name: get_stereo_separation
method.description: Returns the eye separation in use: the value set with [method set_stereo_separation], or the project setting.

method.name: is_charging
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the console is charging. Returns [code]false[/code] outside the 3DS.

method.name: is_new_3ds
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] on a New Nintendo 3DS or 2DS XL, and [code]false[/code] on the original 3DS or 2DS.

method.name: save_screens
method.description: Saves what the screens show after the current frame, as [code]top_left.png[/code], [code]top_right.png[/code] (the two eyes) and [code]bottom.png[/code], into [param dir]. Use it with [method OS.get_user_data_dir] to check the result of a change without a camera.

method.name: set_depth
method.description: Places [param item] in front of ([param depth] > 0) or behind ([param depth] < 0) the screen. The number is in pixels of disparity at full 3D slider, and the slider scales it. A depth of [code]0.0[/code] puts the item on the screen plane, where all 2D items sit by default. Each eye sees the item shifted sideways by half the depth times the slider, rounded to whole pixels so text and sprites stay sharp. The clip rectangle of a clipped item moves with it. Keep depths between about [code]-6[/code] and [code]6[/code]; larger shifts are hard to look at. [b]How it works:[/b] the item gets a [ShaderMaterial] with a [code]stereo_depth[/code] parameter. If [param recursive] is [code]true[/code], descendants without a material of their own use that material and share the depth. A descendant with its own material keeps it and sits at depth [code]0.0[/code], unless you call [method set_depth] on it. [b]Warning:[/b] if the item already has a different material, this replaces it. The editor's Stereo Depth row won't do that: it turns read-only in that case, so put a [code]stereo_depth[/code] uniform on that material yourself.

method.name: set_stereo_convergence
method.description: Sets the convergence (the distance from the camera with no parallax) for the current scene. Pass a negative value to go back to [code]rendering/3ds/stereo/convergence[/code].

method.name: set_stereo_separation
method.description: Sets the eye separation at full 3D slider, in world units, for the current scene. Pass a negative value to go back to [code]rendering/3ds/stereo/max_separation[/code].
